programmes.d: The morning after a couple take shelter with a trapper, the woman is found beaten to death.
Peter Scooper starts a feud between his family and the Galloways when he takes potatoes from the Galloway farm.
A girl asks Matt to save her from her alcoholic father.
Kitty gets shot trying to stop a fight in her saloon.
Doc has gone missing and it is up to Chester to find him.
A girl comes to Dodge on foot after she witnesses her father's murder.
Bank robbers bushwhack Chester on their way to Dodge.
There is something familiar about Tom Cook's new bride.
Matt must prove his innocence when he is accused of beating a man to death.
Matt and Chester find a burnt-down shack and a girl who claims her father died in the blaze.
Matt and Chester track down a horse thief.
A woman named Minnie Higgins falls in love with Doc.
A man nearly kills a couple on their way to Dodge.
A gunrunner gets the Pawnees mad in order to sell his weapons.
A man gets a job, unaware that his boss is trying to make a move on his wife.
A man claims to be a sheriff from Texas, but a murder gets everyone suspicious about him.
Outlaws attack a band of settlers and kill everyone except a pregnant woman who's rescued by a band of Indians.
Chester learns a terrible secret about a girl who is sweet on him.
A retired lawman falls for a saloon hostess on his way to a new life.
A woman is torn between the man she loves and the one her father picked for her.
Matt and Chester must find out who shot two strangers from Colorado.
A stern father wants to see one of his own sons hang for murder - but he picks the wrong boy.
Matt Dillon attempts to temper the anger of a young man when his father takes an Indian woman for his second wife.
A crafty rancher tries to frame his wife with a hired hand in a plot to force money from her father.
An itinerant trail hand attempts to leave Dodge City with the fiance of the man who befriended him.
Chester finds himself the unwilling guardian and nurse of a runaway Indian who has been befriended by a young white girl.
After white men slay his father, half-breed Quint Asper joins the Comanche tribe of his Indian mother so he can avenge the killing. (TV-PG)
After eight years in prison, embittered Collie Patten is unable to adjust to the changes he finds when he returns home.
An untamed nature girl develops a liking for Marshal Matt Dillon and isn't shy about expressing it.
A cowhand accused of murder assists Marshal Dillon when the latter's eyesight is impaired in an attack by three desperadoes. (TV-PG)
Quint Asper, framed as a horse thief by two bad men, angrily leaves town after being beaten up by several Dodge City residents. (TV-PG)
A notorious gunman returns to Dodge City after five years in prison and is unable to convince anyone he has reformed.
